name: alertmanager
description: Prometheus Alertmanager integration — list active alerts and silences, inspect cluster status, and create or expire silences via the Alertmanager v2 REST API. Works with a plain Alertmanager or a token/basic-auth proxied setup.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, silences, and status

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the Alertmanager server (the /api/v2 path is appended automatically).

fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.helpText: Optional bearer token for proxied/authenticated setups.

fields.label: Basic Auth Username
fields.helpText: Optional username for HTTP basic auth (used only when no bearer token is set).

fields.label: Basic Auth Password
fields.helpText: Optional password for HTTP basic auth.

tools.name: alertmanager.list_alerts
tools.description: List alerts currently known to Alertmanager, optionally filtered by active, silenced, or inhibited state.

silenced.description: Include alerts that are silenced (default false)

inhibited.description: Include alerts that are inhibited (default false)

tools.name: alertmanager.list_silences
tools.description: List all silences configured in Alertmanager (active, pending, and expired).

tools.name: alertmanager.get_status
tools.description: Get Alertmanager cluster status, version, and current configuration metadata.

tools.name: alertmanager.create_silence
tools.description: Create a silence that suppresses alerts matching the given matchers for a time window.

matchers.description: Matchers selecting which alerts to silence.

name.description: Label name to match, e.g. alertname

value.description: Label value (or regex pattern when isRegex is true)

isRegex.description: Treat value as a regular expression (default false)

tools.name: alertmanager.expire_silence
tools.description: Expire (delete) an existing silence by its id, so its alerts can fire again.

silenceId.description: The id of the silence to expire
